Due to a permanent cultural festival, there is no direct transit corridor between District Alpha and District Beta.
Furthermore, due to a scheduling mandate, exactly one of the following two transit links must be incorporated into the circuit: the link between District Beta and District Gamma, or the link between District Gamma and District Delta.

The objective is to determine the most time-efficient cyclical itinerary that presents the exhibition in each district precisely once before returning to the initial district.
